messages.text: Could i get a discount code

I don't have discount codes to hand out on new orders, our prices are as listed. I've passed your request to Georges, who can look at it. He picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and will come back to you by email.

Anything you're looking at buying? Happy to help you pick the right miner.
Is there anything for 1st time buyers

No, there's no first-time buyer discount. Prices are the same for everyone, and what you see on the page is what you pay. Georges has your earlier request and will come back to you by email.

What are you after, something small to start with or a bigger unit? Tell me your budget and where it'll run, and I'll point you at the right one.
